name: WF-314 — Property-Level Offer Strategy → Seller Offer Package & Negotiation Launch

parameters.jsCode: const input=$json.body??$json; const deal=input.deal??input; const strategy=input.offer_strategy??deal.offer_strategy??{}; const decision=String(deal.acquisition_decision??strategy.decision??'').toLowerCase(); const mao=Number(strategy.dynamic_mao??deal.adjusted_mao??deal.dynamic_mao); const asking=Number(strategy.asking_price??deal.asking_price??deal.list_price); const projectedProfit=Number(strategy.projected_assignment_profit??deal.projected_assignment_profit??0); const motivation=String(strategy.motivation??deal.motivation_level??'unknown').toLowerCase(); const blockers=Array.isArray(deal.blockers)?deal.blockers:[]; const leadId=deal.lead_id; const dealId=deal.deal_id??deal.id; const propertyId=deal.property_id; const sellerName=deal.seller_name??deal.owner_name??'Seller'; const channel=deal.preferred_channel??deal.channel??'sms'; const evidenceReady=deal.evidence_complete!==false; const valid=Boolean(dealId&&leadId&&propertyId&&Number.isFinite(mao)&&mao>0&&Number.isFinite(asking)&&Number.isFinite(projectedProfit)); if(blockers.length)return [{json:{...deal,workflow_id:'WF-314',status:'blocked',reason:'active blockers',next_workflow:'WF-126'}}]; if(!evidenceReady||!valid)return [{json:{...deal,workflow_id:'WF-314',status:'incomplete',reason:!evidenceReady?'underwriting evidence incomplete':'required offer inputs missing or invalid',next_workflow:'WF-313'}}]; if(!['pursue','negotiate'].includes(decision))return [{json:{...deal,workflow_id:'WF-314',status:'not_offerable',reason:'acquisition decision does not authorize an offer',next_workflow:'WF-313'}}]; const opening=Math.max(0,Math.min(mao,decision==='pursue'?Math.min(asking,mao*0.90):Math.min(asking,mao*0.85))); const target=Math.max(opening,Math.min(mao,asking)); const negotiationRoom=Math.max(0,target-opening); const message='Hi '+sellerName+', I’m reaching out about the property. Based on what we reviewed, we’d like to discuss an offer of $'+Math.round(opening).toLocaleString()+' and see if we can work something out. Are you open to discussing the price?'; const offerPackage={deal_id:dealId,lead_id:leadId,property_id:propertyId,decision,opening_offer:Math.round(opening),negotiation_target:Math.round(target),dynamic_mao:Math.round(mao),negotiation_room:Math.round(negotiationRoom),projected_assignment_profit:projectedProfit,motivation,preferred_channel:channel,message,seller_review_required:true,ma_rule:'secondary_reference_only'}; return [{json:{...deal,workflow_id:'WF-314',workflow_name:'Property-Level Offer Strategy → Seller Offer Package & Negotiation Launch',status:'offer_package_ready',offer_package:offerPackage,next_workflow:'WF-315',crm_activity:{activity_type:'seller_offer_package_ready',deal_id:dealId,lead_id:leadId,property_id:propertyId,status:'offer_package_ready',offer_package:offerPackage}}}];

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { workflow_id: $json.workflow_id, status: $json.status, next_workflow: $json.next_workflow, offer_package: $json.offer_package, crm_persisted: true } }}

meta.description: Builds a seller-facing offer package from the acquisition decision, including opening offer, negotiation target, message, and hard dynamic-MAO protection.
